task.description: Implement OIDC-05 Bearer token acceptance in backend code following src/design/oidc-05-bearer-token-acceptance.md. Extend API-08 Bearer authentication flow to deterministically classify token format and route verification to either OIDC JWT verification or internally-issued token verification (IDN-04), with no ambiguous fallback. Malformed or indeterminate tokens must return HTTP 401 with structured error output. Preserve coexistence: requests with either valid token type succeed. Include code, tests, and any required wiring changes.
acceptance_criteria: OIDC JWT bearer token path authenticates via OIDC verifier
Internal token bearer path authenticates via IDN-04 verifier
Malformed/indeterminate token returns HTTP 401 structured error
Token-type detection is deterministic and does not ambiguously fallback
zig build, zig build test, and zig build migrate exit 0

result.summary: Implemented OIDC-05 deterministic bearer token inspection and route-specific verification in auth middleware, with structured 401 output for indeterminate token formats and updated unit coverage for JWT/internal coexistence routing.
